nexus.name: NEXUS
completed: Established specialist-core routing architecture for AI-assisted development.
Created persistent Nexus chat tables with per-user RLS in Supabase.
Created a global in-product Nexus chat with Gamer and admin-only Development modes.
Implemented official multi-provider inference routing with OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic failover.
Separated inference providers from GitHub, Supabase and Lovable administrative tool bridges.
Configured GPT-5.6 Sol as the default OpenAI model while keeping provider/model selection environment-driven.
Persisted provider/model and relevant specialist cores with assistant messages.
Opened global Gamer chat to anonymous visitors with a ten-successful-response trial and login wall after quota exhaustion.
Added a first-message NEXUS greeting, gamer-native public persona and the original angular N/Z interface mark.
Grounded MGP content recommendations in the live active-games table plus the published content catalog so paused games are not advertised.
Aligned browser and provider timeout budgets so server-side failover can finish before the client abandons a reply.
Preserved the first guest prompt during session bootstrap instead of silently dropping an early Enter submission.
Verified the hosted Supabase nexus-inference Edge Function is active at version 8 and aligned with the repository runtime.
Published the NEXUS / Os Sete council area in the product navigation with visible core names, sigil letters, specialist roles and distinct accent identities.
Separated transient NEXUS health failures from confirmed no-provider state so the UI no longer reports a disconnected AI engine merely because status loading failed.

Established the Visual System v2 foundation: a customizable semantic interface signal color, a quick appearance control in the global header, and a shared interaction language designed to avoid generic AI/gamer UI clichés.

Expanded the MG Profile identity/loadout foundation so profile customization has explicit slots for backgrounds, banners, avatar frames, cursors, profile effects, chibis and badges while keeping game-inspired assets rights-gated.

Aligned this VALORANT completion pass with MG Profile’s product purpose: gamer identity, social discovery, forums/community content, guides/builds/tutorials and LFG rather than a standalone esports database.
Removed the internal NEXUS/Os Sete council from public navigation and turned /nexus into a noindex redirect so public visitors only interact with the NEXUS gamer chat surface.

Hardened NEXUS inference against transient provider failures: provider requests now use abortable 25s timeouts, one retry for transient 429/5xx/network failures, low-latency reasoning in gamer mode, and explicit 503 handling for NEXUS_ALL_PROVIDERS_FAILED.

Added a transparent independent-project support area that explains the founder story, AI-assisted/human-led development model, current low-budget stage, non-financial ways to help and voluntary financial support boundaries.
Prepared Google as the first social sign-in path across login, registration and the logged-out header while keeping email/password authentication available.
inProgress: Verify at least one official inference provider credential is present in Supabase Edge Function deployment secrets; keys stored only in Lovable or GitHub do not make NEXUS aiReady.
Continue page-by-page visual art-direction review on top of Visual System v2 after the foundation PR is merged and rendered in Lovable.
next: Configure at least one official inference API credential in deployment secrets and test live model replies end to end.
Add the GitHub App bridge as the first write-capable Nexus development tool using branch/review/merge by default.
Add explicit human-approval gates before destructive or production-impacting tool actions.
Consider an opt-in multi-model council mode only for difficult admin tasks after normal failover is stable.
After the VALORANT completion pass, move the same product/content standard to League of Legends, then Dark Souls Remastered/Dark Souls III, then Elden Ring before the broader public test.
